space.$description: Semantic spacing ladder. Engineers consume these — never the dimension.* primitives. The integer suffix matches the primitive scale (space.4 = 16px) for predictability and Tailwind utility parity. v0.8 added 1_5/7/9/11/14 stops + space.inset.* / space.inset.squish.* / space.inset.stretch.* / space.section.dense / space.section.hero.

1_5.$description: v0.8 — 6 px sub-grid for optical adjustment.

stack.$description: Vertical rhythm — gaps between stacked elements within a section.

inline.$description: Horizontal gaps within a row of elements (icon + label, button group).

inset.$description: v0.8 — padding INSIDE a container. Use for component padding, button padding, card padding, popover padding. Components MUST reach here, not into the integer ladder.

sm.$description: 8 px — input padding-y at md, button padding-y at sm.

md.$description: 12 px — input padding-x at md, card sm padding.

lg.$description: 16 px — input padding-x at lg, card md padding.

squish.$description: v0.8 — paired x/y for controls where x > y (button, chip, segmented). Atlassian's compositional pattern; Curtis 2016.

stretch.$description: v0.8 — paired x/y for controls where y > x (textarea, prose card). Less common but documents the intent.

section.$description: Vertical gap between major sections of a page. v0.8 added dense (operator) and hero (marketing-extreme) tiers — see ADR 0014 for the operator-vs-marketing split.

dense.$description: v0.8 — 24 px operator-dashboard section break. Aliased as .operator.

sm.$description: v0.8 — 32 px tight band (was 40 px in v0.7; reduced to converge with Linear).

md.$description: v0.8 — 48 px default band (was 48 px; unchanged).

hero.$description: v0.8 — 96 px Vercel-style marketing hero. Used on /landing.

operator.$description: v0.8 alias — operator dashboards default to dense.

marketing.$description: v0.8 alias — marketing pages default to lg.

page.$description: Outer padding of the page container.

table.$description: v0.8 — table-cell rhythm. Apple Sport pattern: column gap stays constant when type scales.
